entities.summary: Anna Maria Corazza Bildt is an Italian-Swedish entrepreneur and politician, Member of the European Parliament between 2009 and 2019. She was elected as a member of the Swedish Moderate Party, but switched to Liberalerna ahead of the 2024 European Parliament election.
